title_zh: 商量隐私有限的工作安排询问

scenario.label_zh: 商量隐私有限的工作安排询问
scenario.goal_zh: 明确本人愿意分享的健康信息范围并约定先向经理询问安排而不保证获批

context_zh: 虚构职场沟通练习。Maya 自述已知的慢性疲劳综合征，Ben 是同事；对话不作诊断或治疗建议。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: I want to tell our manager I have chronic fatigue syndrome, but I don't want a medical discussion with the whole team.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: You can decide what you're comfortable sharing. Do you want the email to focus on the work arrangements you're asking about?

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Yes. I don't want to discuss any underlying health issues beyond that.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Then let's draft a private request for a later start on meeting days, and explain that you're trying to protect your well-being.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: That would help. Can you read the draft before I send it?

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Of course. We can make the request clear, though the manager still has to respond.
